narrative: The tables lie open on the desk at the lodging. The street is not in the frame. A pen rests in the gutter of the leaf. No hand. A corner of the comedy's last leaf, brought home from yesterday. One short line in the margin. A softer ending is begun and struck. The same tables. No sum is added. The Cheapside line is a memorandum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the three notes and stayed in the room.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
